items.text: A good career objective for a business analyst or business administration fresher names the target role, one piece of proof from a spreadsheet, report or process you handled, and what you can do for the team, in two or three short lines.
Write the role, one proof that can be checked, the tool or method you used and what you offer.
What recruiters do: They skim for the role name, a tool such as Excel or SQL and a result.
